## 📋 Quality Checklist

Please verify the following before submitting:

- [ ] Source is actively maintained (updated in last 6 months)
- [ ] Content is high-quality and reputable
- [ ] Source is primarily in English
- [ ] URL is correct and accessible
- [ ] Not a duplicate of existing sources
- [ ] Not promotional/spam content
- [ ] Free or freemium (if paid, clearly noted)
